title: Godot 4.5.dev5.mono.official crashes on @GDScript and @GlobalScope help file access
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in `v4.5.dev5.mono.official (64b09905c7b2877f8aef99d8b63e73e5d31acfb9)`
-Not reproducible in `v4.3.stable.official.77dcf97d8`

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev5.mono - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M (RADV GFX1103_R1) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840U w/ Radeon  780M Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

Just a simple lookup on how `randi_range` works crashes `godot`

#### Updates
It appears ALL help files that fall under `@GDScript` and `@GlobalScope` crash

### Steps to reproduce

Open or start a new project
Press F1 (Search Help) and type in `randi_range` for the documentation on the globally scoped `randi_range` function
Press enter or select it
Godot should crash with a backtrace like the one above

Note that other help files are accessible, e.g. `Tween`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Can reproduce this with a completely blank and new game in Godot
